review_candidates.title: Front Office Receptionist
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This position is responsible for greeting visitors, managing check-ins, directing guests to the appropriate departments, and maintaining a professional and welcoming front office environment. Daily tasks include answering and routing phone calls, responding to inquiries, handling incoming and outgoing mail, and supporting basic administrative activities such as scheduling appointments and updating visitor logs. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Receptionist Duties and Front Office
eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Front Office Receptionist is a full-time, on-site role based in Giza.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Receptionist Duties and Front Office skills, including visitor management and basic administrative support. Basic computer literacy, including proficiency in email, calendars, and office software.
